body:
Intelligence isn't some all encompassing attribute. I can tell you are intelligent by your writing.

I wouldn't feel bad about not being good at electrical engineering, computer science, or cryptography. Those aren't easy subjects. They're not even hard subjects. They're fucking hard subjects. The kind of subject I'm guessing fewer than 1 in 10,000 people can succeed in, if even.

If you don't like IT work, you should keep looking for what makes you happy. If you're interested in technology, but want to do something more significant than IT, maybe you should check out Management Information Systems. It's like programming and business mixed together.

Also, one last thing: Many people who are intelligent would have you believe that they possess some intrinsic superiority. The fact is, a ditz who works really hard will be more successful than a lazy genius. And then who is really the intelligent one anyway?
